timing_scope.completed_episode_metrics: completed episodes with a host result and no infrastructure error; censored scheduler receipts do not remove exact physical or policy timing

timing_scope.observed_infrastructure_batch_wall_s: exact observed scheduler duration of infrastructure failures; not a completed-episode duration
